title: Certify eight-query minimum for the saved binary two-burst schedule
body:
## Summary

Finite certificate over F2: eight rank-one thin queries are necessary and sufficient for the saved PR #5699 schedule. The six full calls stay in order `(1,3,2,4,0,5)` and thin queries occur only after two and four full calls.

```text
two aggregate matrices, 128 binary entries
  -> all 1,728 endpoint coefficient equations
  -> rank 104, 24 free coordinates
  -> all 16,777,216 solutions
  -> minimum aggregate rank sum 8
  -> at least 8 rank-one queries
```

This answers the predecessor's first Open next question for its saved gap pair. The new contribution is the lower bound. Credit theon199 for PR #5699's attaining eight-query square-zero construction and explicit question, Ali Romman for PR #5673's full matrices and normalized model, and Cinna Davis with the retained controller/native/helper/compiler lineage. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before: eight queries were an upper bound; the source explicitly left fewer thin queries open. After: every feasible aggregate pair in this fixed binary schedule has rank sum at least eight. Rank subadditivity proves the query lower bound, and the cited construction attains it.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only. The direct warning-strict verifier and both registered normal/optimized exhaustive replays pass. Each includes all 16,777,216 pairs, 512 independent kernel/rank controls and nine boundary, rejection or enumeration controls. The complete rank-pair histogram also agrees with the discovery calculation. The verifier imports no predecessor code and prints a generated receipt bound to package and input SHA256 hashes.

Exact reproduction from the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-burst-thin-rank/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/two-burst-thin-rank/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-burst-thin-rank
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-burst-thin-rank --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Use the corresponding CPython 3.12 path on another host. Expected `PASS_TWO_BURST_THIN_RANK`, `solutions=16777216`, `minimum_rank_sum=8`, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Both registered checks were also individually timed at 33.699s and 34.327s. Metadata/pins, committed bytes/executable modes, full declared-source ancestry and the official ten-file export with all three declared inputs pass. A read-only Git-free optimized export replay with an empty PATH also passes in 33.13s and preserves all 11 exported files.

## Limitations

The certificate covers F2, these exact full matrices/order and these two gaps. Extension fields, changed schedules, extra full calls, stage-dependent thin entries, native lifts, physical restoration and complete supplier/outer admission remain outside it. No Lean/kernel proof or independent human review is claimed. The predecessor's optimistic invoice is cited, not replayed. All five framework assumptions retain their status. All new files are confined to `research/two-burst-thin-rank/`.

## Open next questions

- Can a different gap pair, full-call order or more occupied gaps admit seven binary queries? Start from the changed complete coefficient system. Require a favorable complete invoice before physical expansion.
- Does the rank-sum bound extend to nonbinary characteristic-two fields? The same 24-parameter affine system is a symbolic starting point; no extension-field claim follows from the binary census.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this fixed eight-field full order and two-gap thin-query count was found in the live 448-open-PR body scan, the refreshed recent open list or the latest handoff claims. PR #5699 and PR #5673 are merged predecessors. This coverage excludes unpublished work and does not establish global novelty.

## CI notes

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. No shared implementation, frozen source, selected result or predecessor credit is changed.
